Avoid unnecessary test matrices or framework/install overhead. Record exact final SHA256 hashes of all owned payloads, resolved/open findings and coverage in author record.

canonical_spec.title: Value creation and capital budgeting
canonical_spec.outcome: Evaluate incremental project cash flows and reconcile NPV with decision criteria.

assignments.scope: Incremental project cash flows; time-0 versus end-date spending; operating taxes/depreciation shield/after-tax disposal and working-capital recovery under explicit fictional tax rules; opportunity cost/cannibalization/sunk costs. Derive NPV and value-additivity for appropriate supplied discount factors; IRR computation/meaning, unique conventional case and multiple/no-IRR counterexamples; mutually exclusive scale/timing rankings and incremental comparison. Distinguish financing from project operating cash and value from budget feasibility. Unequal-life comparison only under stated service/replacement horizon. Avoid unsupported claim that a ranking conflict is mechanically caused by an assumed IRR reinvestment rate.

Adjacent work may draft concurrently against this contract, but acceptance follows c01->c02->c03->c04.

canonical_spec.title: Free cash flow and discounting
canonical_spec.outcome: Derive cash flows to the firm and equity and choose consistent discount rates.

assignments.scope: Derive FCFF from operations and FCFE from net income and from FCFF with interest/tax/net borrowing. Distinguish enterprise operating value from total firm/equity value, cash/nonoperating assets/debt claims and ex-dividend timing. Show coherent finite cash-flow/valuation reconciliation using supplied consistent rates and financing policy; never force equality with inconsistent debt evolution or double-count shields. Teach nominal-real rate/cash consistency and currency conversion with explicitly dated hypothetical exchange path/discount rates. Introduce terminal value as date-H remaining continuation cash claim with convergence assumptions, leaving ROIC/growth/fade depth to c03 and rate estimation to c04. No current market observations.

canonical_spec.title: Valuation models and terminal assumptions
canonical_spec.outcome: Value an operating business using explicit growth and reinvestment economics.

assignments.scope: Multistage DCF with explicit continuation date/next-period cash, operating-to-equity bridge, coherent NOPAT/invested-capital/reinvestment stock-flow path. Derive g=ROIC_new*reinvestment under the exact capital productivity/timing conditions and stable FCFF=NOPAT*(1-g/ROIC), g<discount rate, sustainable margins/leverage and growth. Separate return on existing capital from incremental return, explain growth can destroy value, show finite fade/competitive convergence with a fully closed original forecast and terminal conditions. Sensitivity to g/r and terminal share; no mechanical perpetuity when assumptions fail. Supplied discount rates; c04 will teach estimation.

canonical_spec.title: Risk, cost of capital and WACC
canonical_spec.outcome: Estimate financing costs and explain when WACC is inappropriate.

assignments.scope: Risk, cost of capital and WACC: supplied/estimated risk-free benchmark and equity premium, covariance beta with risk-versus-total-volatility distinction and conditional CAPM introduction; marginal borrowing cost versus coupon/YTM under default, market weights and usable marginal tax shield; levered/unlevered beta assumptions, project/comparable risk, nominal/currency/period matching and stable-policy WACC limits. Teach fixed debt/changing leverage or constrained tax use as APV/explicit financing cases instead of blindly reusing WACC. Full original numerical lab and at least eight solved exercises; all market-like numbers hypothetical.
